% Flow diagrams of the ten algorithms, generated by tools/report/gen_flows.py: one row, at most six boxes and one decision
% each, plain words (the equations are in the text and in the algorithm after each figure).
% Green = data in / out, blue = step, orange = decision. Each \flow... macro is a figure placed right before its algorithm.

\tikzset{
  flow/.style={font=\fontsize{8}{9.4}\selectfont},
  fd/.style={draw=green!40!black,fill=green!9,rounded corners=5pt,text width=2.05cm,align=center,inner sep=2.5pt,minimum height=11mm},
  fs/.style={draw=blue!45!black,fill=blue!6,rounded corners=1.5pt,text width=2.05cm,align=center,inner sep=2.5pt,minimum height=11mm},
  fq/.style={draw=orange!75!black,fill=orange!13,rounded corners=1.5pt,text width=2.05cm,align=center,inner sep=2.5pt,minimum height=11mm,
             double,double distance=0.6pt},
  fa/.style={-{Latex[length=1.6mm]},semithick,black!65},
  yes/.style={font=\fontsize{7.5}{8.5}\selectfont\itshape,text=black!70,inner sep=1.5pt},
}

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Clip
\newcommand{\flowClip}{%
\begin{figure}[htbp]
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}[flow]
\node[fd] (n0) at (0.00,0) {scene parts};
\node[fs] (n1) at (2.73,0) {bounding sphere of each part};
\node[fq] (n2) at (5.47,0) {outside the view volume?};
\node[fs] (n3) at (8.20,0) {vertex shader: to clip space};
\node[fs] (n4) at (10.93,0) {clip triangles at the six planes};
\node[fd] (n5) at (13.67,0) {triangles inside the view};
\draw[fa] (n0)--(n1);
\draw[fa] (n1)--(n2);
\draw[fa] (n2)--node[yes,above]{no}(n3);
\draw[fa] (n3)--(n4);
\draw[fa] (n4)--(n5);
\node[fs] (b) at (5.47,-1.75) {skip the part};
\draw[fa] (n2)--node[yes,right]{yes}(b);
\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{Flow of Algorithm~\ref{alg:clip}: whole parts are culled on the CPU (central processing unit) (\code{math/Frustum.cpp}); the GPU (graphics processing unit) clips the triangles of the parts that remain.}
\label{fig:flow-clip}
\end{figure}}
